content: चक्षुष्य {%a.%} [चक्षुते हितः यत्] .²1 Good looking, agreeable to the sight, pleasing, beautiful; <ls>Śi. 8. 57</ls>. .²2 Good for the eyes. .²3 Produced from the eye; देवतानां पितॄणां च चक्षुष्यं चात्मनां विभो <ls>Mb. 13. 68. 28</ls>. .{@-ष्यः, -ष्या@} A collyrium or application to the eyes. .{@-ष्या@} A pleasing or agreeable woman. .{@-ष्यम्@} An ointment for the eyes (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>सुरमा ?</ns>); तार्क्ष्यशैलं शिखिग्रीवं चक्षुष्यं यामुनं पुनः <ls>Śiva B. 30. 18</ls>.
